messages:
deploy-bot: [deploy queued] config-only change scheduled for staging · canary -> 5% at 14:00 UTC. cfg-id: cfg-2026-03-21-174812. Notes: no model weights, routing/batching/limits only.

maria: ack. quick summary of concrete diffs?

deploy-bot: diffs: `tenant_burst` 30 -> 20, `default_timeout_ms` 12000 -> 10000, `routing.policy` fallback prefer-dense -> prefer-low-latency for `tier=standard`, `batching.window_ms` 8 -> 6. canary duration 60m (5% 20m -> 30% 40m). auto-rollback: enabled (1% error over 5m).

noah: why the lower burst? risk on sudden spikes?

maria: primary: reduce token-cost on chat-echo traffic. perf sims from eng-ml showed ~4% cost reduction. small risk for large single-tenant spikes; we've added short TTL warmup = 10s to soften cold penalties.

chris: request: pin staging to `model:v2.1-rc3` for the duration — previous drift when mixed variants served.

maria: done — `model_pin: model:v2.1-rc3` for staging only. fallback path if canary fails: unpin to `model:v2.0` + revert routing change.

ops-sre: can we move canary start earlier? I'm oncall from 15:00 UTC and prefer start at 14:00 so I can monitor the 14:20 -> 14:40 ramp.

maria: updated schedule: start 14:00 UTC, 14:00-14:20 observe @5%, 14:20 -> 14:50 roll to 30% if metrics ok. Observability hooks: `/alerts/canary-latency`, `/alerts/canary-error-rate`, dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/canary/1748123456

deploy-bot: 14:00 UTC — canary started (canary-id: canary-1748123456). Routing change applied to 5% cohort.

noah: watching logs — saw a single 503 at 14:04 from tenant=payments-staging. brief spike, not widespread.

chris: saw same in traces — likely a downstream retry; routing bias to low-latency reduced cold starts for small seqs.

maria: checks: QoR regression tests passed on sampled prompts, no sign of model-quality drift.

ops-sre: hold for 5 — investigating that 503 (checking backend pool utilization). will signal rollback if >1% errors across 5m window.

maria: understood. rollback plan: immediate `deploy-bot rollback canary-1748123456` -> revert config, unpin model, notify #incidents and oncall.

deploy-bot: 14:28 UTC — ops-sre approved rollforward. rolling to 30% now.

chris: adding release note snippet: "Config-only: tenant burst cap reduced (30->20), timeouts tightened (12s->10s), routing bias set to prefer-low-latency for standard tier, batching window reduced (8->6ms). Staging pinned to model:v2.1-rc3; auto-rollback on >1% errors over 5m."

maria: added that to the release-notes doc: https://go/redwood/release-notes/2026-03-21-config. also leaving a short runbook entry for ops: `if tail latency > 99.9th by 50ms for 10m -> revert routing + increase batch window to 10ms`

noah: :thumbsup: I'll keep an eye on traces for the next hour.

ops-sre: 14:50 check-in: metrics stable, error rate < 0.2%. happy to promote to prod canary next week during the morning change window.

maria: great — closing thread. follow-up: schedule prod change window and coordinate sales for potential customer-impact notice.
